gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-parkinsans: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz packs big bodies into every lowercase letter. Capture Smallz does its best work shouting; Parkinsans does its best work staying crisp, its wide-mouthed, wire-like lines holding up when shrunk.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-pathway-ext: Pathway Extreme reads clean and modern, with rounded letters kept clearly open and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. But Capture Smallz brings the raw, tactical punch, its big-bodied lowercase giving the sans text something to push against.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-preahvihear: Capture Smallz hits with raw, tactical force, its lowercase built big and bodied. Preahvihear takes over below, its open mouth and lofty x-height making paragraph after paragraph feel contemporary and unhurried.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-prompt: Approachable and unfussy, the body text has oversized small letters and apertures that stay readily open. Prompt does the quiet reading, while Capture Smallz is best at raw, tactical impact with its big-bodied lowercase.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-pt-sans-cap: Big-bodied lowercase letters give Capture Smallz its raw, tactical swagger. PT Sans Caption leaves its bowls unclosed and inviting, a professional, contemporary sans-serif that lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-puritan: Capture Smallz is best at raw, tactical attitude, its big-bodied lowercase doing the loud work. Puritan excels at approachable clarity, its rounded sans forms staying open to the side around oversized e and a counters.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-questrial: Questrial reads flat and stencil-cut, its single-weight strokes forming a tall band of letters. But against Capture Smallz's raw, big-bodied lowercase, line after line of this sans feels modern and open.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-radio-canad: Tactical and raw, Capture Smallz excels at big-bodied lowercase. Radio Canada does its best work in a steady sans-serif line, with tall, full c, s and z and a clear opening at every curve's end.

Neutral in mood, Radio Canada Big is monoline from start to finish. Capture Smallz is best at raw, big-bodied lowercase attitude, while the plain sans body finishes its terminals well away from the stem, with no swelling.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-readex-pro: This sans reads smoothly, with broad terminal gaps and a calm weight that never shifts along a curve. Readex Pro stays quiet, which leaves Capture Smallz, raw and tactical, to earn its keep big and short.
